description: Non material amendment to Ref: 22/03346/OUT (as amended by 25/02507/NMA) to allow amendments to the trigger dates wording for condition (F15) Details of Access and Wind Mitigation to Rooftops and Balconies, and condition (H34) Landscape and Ecological Management Plan.
decision_conditions: F15. Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, the construction of Blocks A, N and K within a development plot of the Detailed Element for of the hereby permitted development shall not progress beyond the installation of any permanent balcony or roof terrace balustrades until revised details of wind mitigation to the roof terraces and balconies for the respective building has first been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. The revised details shall include:a) In respect of Block A, measures to ensure no adverse wind conditions to balconies;b) i) In respect of Blocks N and K, a revised layout for each of the roof terraces which contributes to privacy for neighbouring occupiers and comfort for users of the roof terraces for Blocks N and K;ii) hard and soft landscaping details for blocks N and K;iii)details of measures to address noise levels and wind microclimate; andiv) details of how inclusive access to and within communal rooftop gardens is achieved for all residents of the block.The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the development achieves safe, comfortable and attractive amenity spaces.

H34. Prior to commencement of landscape works in a development Plot, a landscape management plan, including long-term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all landscaped areas including temporary landscaped areas, trees, terrace planters, roof planting, ground level landscaping, climbing planters and ecological features, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The management plan shall be carried out as approved and any subsequent variations shall be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: to provide acceptable usable space for future occupiers and in the interests of visual amenity and biodiversity
